I **love** to travel and explore the world. Below I have mapped out some of my favorite places around the world.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(leaflet)
```

```{r}

leaflet(data = favorite_place) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(color = ~c("red", "blue", "green", "purple")[as.factor(kind)], label = ~place) %>%
    addLegend(
    colors = c("red", "blue", "green", "purple"),
    labels = c("Cute Town/Street", "Fun Activity", "Great View" , "Restaurant"),
    title = "Place Type")

#I wanted to challenge myself and use a leaflet map. I did this by referring to the leaflet guide made by  rstudio on their website when I was unsure of how to make something work. For example using the (as.factor) argument for the colors.

```
